sermons.title: John 18v28-19v12 | Why Are You Rejecting Christ? | Abhinav Perepogu
sermons.description:
Bible Passage: John 18v28-19v12
Sermon Title: Why Are You Rejecting Christ?
Preacher: Abhinav Perepogu.
Date Preached: 1st November 2026

Why Are You Rejecting Christ? There are lots of reasons given. Pilate is an interesting example of someone who listened to Christ, and found no fault in him, heard all sorts of things about him, and would have released him, yet he did not, either because of fear of the world or love of the world. For you is it fear of the world or love of the world that causes you to reject Christ?

sermons.title: 2 Corinthians 5v21
sermons.description:
Expository Gospel ministry on 2 Corinthians 5v21, preached at Grace Chapel on Sunday 25th October 2026, by John Antalika. Do we know what our biggest problem is? It's not illness, disease, or threats from other nations, it is sin. Sin cuts us off from God, and our sin condemns us. How then can we be reconciled to God? How can we be sinless? Only through Jesus Christ, who takes away our sin and gives us His righteousness. Come and hear about this Saviour every Sunday afternoon.

sermons.title: Philemon v10-25
sermons.description:
Bible Study (1st November 2022). Preached by Joshua Oliver.
The final part to a three part series on the book of Philemon. Paul makes a gentle and heart searching appeal for Onesimus, commending him greatly, and encouraging Philemon to love and mercy. Have we be gentle, loving, forgiving and, like Onesimus, profitable to God and the church.

sermons.title: 2 Corinthians 7 v10
sermons.description: Gospel message (30th October 2022). The prodigal son came to his sense and gained a godly sorrow. True sorrow for sin can only come from a changed heart given by God, do we have such a heart?

sermons.title: Luke 12 v48b
sermons.description: Doctrinal ministry (Sunday 30th October 2022). The concluding message to a series of three on the sovereignty of God. How do we respond to the fact that God is sovereign? Do we need to make any effort?

sermons.title: Philemon 4-11
sermons.description:
Bible Study (25th October 2022). Preached by Joshua Oliver.
What is it to pray for another person? How are we to behave towards Christ, and towards the saints?

sermons.title: Luke 15 v31
sermons.description: Why do the wicked prosper? And why do the godly suffer? Surely this is only temporarily the case, and furthermore the believer has Christ, whilst the believer misses out on this great blessing.

sermons.title: Luke 15 v13-14
sermons.description: Gospel ministry (Sunday 23rd October 2022). The prodigal son already proved he had a rebellious heart, and now we see how foolish that heart is.

sermons.title: Philemon 1-3
sermons.description:
Bible Study (18th October 2022). Preached by Joshua Oliver.
Paul's shortest epistle still has so much to say. Why did Paul write to Philemon? Why did he write the way he did? What can we learn about christian unity, love, and forgiveness?

sermons.title: Isaiah 1 v2
sermons.description:
Gospel ministry (16th October 2022).
The natural heart of man is in rebellion against God.

sermons.title: Amos 3v6b
sermons.description:
Doctrinal ministry (16th October 2022).
Can christians expect suffering in this world? If so why? What can we learn from suffering? And where do our struggles come from?
